results.title: Duplicate token ids and malformed token values are both rejected before emitting operations
results.requirement: A duplicate id and an unparseable colour both produce a named violation, and nothing is emitted for the bad token.
results.detail: 4 invalid token problems reported and the run is inapplicable

violations: Token id 'space' is declared 2 times (entries 1, 2). Token ids must be unique.
Token 'brand' (id 'space') declares DEFAULT='#ZZZZZZ', which is not a colour. Use #RRGGBB, #RGB, #RRGGBBAA, rgb(r,g,b), rgba(r,g,b,a) or 'transparent'.
Token 'space-md' (id 'gap') declares DEFAULT='wide', which is not a number.
Token 'nothing' (id 'empty') declares no values, so it creates a variable nothing can reference.
1 content node(s) were declared without a parent region and were placed in 'card': 't'. Add a parent to place them deliberately.
